title: The Normal temperature of the child
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：normal　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 normal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the herder wrote of ① a normal temperature of the child in the ledger, and everybody in the pasture said at once that it was ② more normal than the one named there the year before. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the herder, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the normal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most normal temperature of the child anybody in the pasture had ever seen, or so the ledger for December 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too normal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the normal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a normal day at the office, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as normal as the day at the office they had once had in the old pasture. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was normal or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something normal, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next pasture called the whole plan ⑧ quite normal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the normal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, year after year, she wrote of another normal temperature of the child in the same ledger, and the work, which took two winters, seemed ⑨ more normal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most normal day at the office in the whole pasture, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the normal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 正常（前置定语 a normal temperature of the child：1963 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的那件正常的体温）
B. adj. 正常／平常（比较级 more normal than：文中两处，一处比孩子正常的体温，一处比预想）
C. adj. 正常／平常（最高级 the most normal：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 正常（表语 too normal to do：母亲觉得它太正常，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 平常（前置定语 a normal day at the office：叔叔把整件事称作一桩平常的一天）
F. adj. 平常（同级比较 as normal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩办公室寻常的一天相比）
G. adj. 平常（后置定语 something normal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 平常（受程度副词修饰 quite normal：那位邻人的评价）

items.q: a normal temperature of the child
the most normal temperature of the child anybody
a normal day at the office
The most normal day at the office in

answers.why: normal 意为“正常”，1963 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的是“一件正常的体温”，此处作前置定语 a normal temperature of the child。
normal 意为“正常”，此处用比较级 more normal than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
normal 意为“正常”，牧群台账上 十二月 那行字说它是牧场里最正常的一件，故用最高级 the most normal temperature of the child。
normal 意为“正常”，母亲认为这件东西“太正常了，谁也用不上”，too normal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
normal 意为“平常”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩平常的一天”，此处作前置定语 a normal day at the office。
normal 意为“平常”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩办公室寻常的一天一样平常”，同级比较用 as normal as。
normal 意为“平常”，牧群台账上那半行字要的是“平常的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something normal。
normal 意为“平常”，邻牧场来的那位邻人认为这套计划“相当平常”，quite 修饰原级 normal。
normal 意为“平常”，1973 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要平常”，故用比较级 more normal than。
normal 意为“平常”，母亲 1975 年说的是“整个牧场里最平常的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most normal day at the office。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，牧人在牧群台账里记下了一件正常的体温。（a normal temperature of the child）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更正常。（more normal than …）
母亲觉得它太正常，谁也用不上。（too normal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩平常的一天。（a normal day at the office）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩办公室寻常的一天一样平常。（as normal as …）
到了 1970 年，牧群台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件平常的东西。（something normal）
answers: In 1963 the herder wrote of a normal temperature of the child in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more normal than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too normal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a normal day at the office.
He said nobody would call it as normal as the day at the office they had once had.
By 1970 the ledger asked for nothing but something normal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 normal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the herder wrote of a normal temperature of the child in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most normal temperature of the child in the pasture, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too normal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a normal day at the office, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next pasture called the plan quite normal, and everybody laughed.
The normal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
